title: A Failed Expedition: Shargone
summary: Investigate the lost expedition and awaken Shargone after clearing enough enemies.
overview: Investigate the lost expedition and awaken Shargone after clearing enough enemies.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Speak to the survivor and stabilize the group before reaching twenty kills.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The twentieth non-pet kill in the zone summons Shargone once.
Kallendro offers a protective fireskin effect when hailed; the expedition corpses provide clues.
Prepare for the boss before the final qualifying kill.

notes: Approval E352. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
